description: This header file declares functions related to metal optimization passes in the Torch JIT compiler, including inserting pre-packed operations, fusing convolutions with clamps, folding pre-packing operations, and optimizing modules for mobile deployment.

methods.name: metalInsertPrePackedOps
methods.description: Inserts pre-packed ops into the computational graph or module to optimize execution.

methods.name: metalFusePrePackedConvWithClamp
methods.description: Fuses a pre-packed convolution operation with a clamp operation to optimize performance.

methods.name: metalFoldPrePackingOps
methods.description: Folds pre-packing operations within a module for efficiency.

methods.name: metalOptimizeForMobile
methods.description: Optimizes a script module for mobile deployment, preserving specified methods.
